label: SHG collagen, human dermis
description: Second-harmonic generation image of collagen in unstained human reticular dermis (PSHG-TISS skin_12, CC BY 4.0), summed over nine laser polarisations.
expectedResult: Orientation, coherency and energy maps, a colour survey and an orientation distribution peaking near 90° for the mostly vertical collagen bundles.

label: Synthetic 3D fibres
description: Synthetic 64 × 64 × 32 stack of two fibre lattices with known directions, for the 3D analysis; not real tissue.
expectedResult: Azimuth 30° and elevation 0° in the left half, azimuth −45° and elevation 40° in the right half, and a direction colour map.
